message:
Running command: cat > /tmp/fuzz.py <<'EOF'
import struct, subprocess, os, random, sys

LRI=0x2066; RLI=0x2067; FSI=0x2068; PDI=0x2069
# also embeddings
LRE=0x202A; RLE=0x202B; LRO=0x202D; RLO=0x202E; PDF=0x202C
chars=[LRI,RLI,FSI,PDI,LRE,RLE,LRO,RLO,PDF]

def gen(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    n = random.randint(1, 300)
    return [random.choice(chars) for _ in range(n)]

def run(seq):
    data = b''.join(struct.pack('<I', c) for c in seq)
    open('/tmp/fz.bin','wb').write(data)
    r = subprocess.run(['/tmp/driver','/tmp/fz.bin'], capture_output=True, env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0'})
    return r.returncode, r.stderr

for seed in range(20000):
    seq = gen(seed)
    rc, err = run(seq)
    if rc != 0:
        print("CRASH seed", seed, "rc", rc)
        print("seq:", [hex(c) for c in seq])
        print(err.decode()[-3000:])
        open('/tmp/crash_seq.txt','w').write(repr(seq))
        sys.exit(0)
print("no crash in 20000")
EOF
cd /tmp && timeout 300 python3 /tmp/fuzz.py
